name: H to 4-methylcatechol
summary: A 4-step route from H(+) to 4-methylcatechol, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

relations.note: Shares 2-hydroxy-5-methyl-cis,cis-muconic semialdehyde with L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate to H2O.
